name: SARRACENIA PURPUREA
key_symptoms: Hungry all the time, even after a meal. Sleepy during meals. Copious, painful vomiting.
Limbs weak; bruised pain in knees and hip-joints. Bones in arm pain. Weak between shoulders.
Pains shooting in zig-zag course from lumbar region to middle of scapula.

head_symptoms: Photophobia. Eyes feel swollen and sore. Pain in orbits. Black objects move with the eye.
